headline: Crude oil advances toward fourth monthly gain following Hormuz tanker attack
summary: Brent crude prices rose following an attack on an oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, highlighting persistent supply disruption risks in Middle Eastern waterways.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the primary global maritime transit point for crude exports originating from Gulf oil producers.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Military incidents in strategic maritime shipping lanes insert supply premium risks into crude oil pricing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Security risks affecting maritime transit through the Strait of Hormuz raised supply threat premiums.
